author: SilverBullet4869
body:
Hello Avicus,
I want to be unbanned. Well I got banned before getting warned (ManCityForever). The mod _Poseidon__ banned me before getting warned. Now I think that should be the reason for me to be unbanned but I have more reasons. I got banned because I was disrespectful I didn't swear at the mod in my last text on Avicus. Now _Poseidon__ if you are reading this how am I supposed to know that 2 kicks result to a Temperory Ban? Anyway I am not trying to be rude. Now to the last stage why I think I should be unbanned, look I am sorry that I was disrespectful and I won't do it again and if I do it by accident (if you unban me) be sure to warn me before banning me for the second time. Anyway the reason that caused me to be banned was the fact I swore at someone then without me getting warned the mod _Posiedon__ kicked me which got me to get outraged and my friend saw that a person said thank you because the mod kicked me I got banned at the person so I spleefed him out of the world then again the mod kicked me then I went to saying things to the mod then he banned me. Anyway I hope you unban me but I want to say this mods on this server should not ban a person without warning them. In the past I got a mod warning me before I get kicked and a mod warning me before I get banned for a period of time. Mods are supposed to warn people before they get banned ESPECIALLY if it is a temperary ban. Never in my life on Avicus I have seen a mod ban someone before warning them for example (PauloG0D) is a player who got banned for 3 days for team greifing and he got warned before getting banned. Anyway I hope you accept my reasons to be unbanned from Avicus and I have never been banned on any server.
Kind Regards,
ManCityForever

Hello,

Looking at your past infractions you don't seem to have learnt your lesson on your behaviour, however I must credit you on how much time you've put into your appeal. The ban expires in a few hours so in the meantime I suggest you read through the rules so you don't get into this mess again -> https://avicus.net/rules.
-Denied

Regards,
Auratix_
